generation_method: Live model-generated courtesy opening and closing, assembled with deterministic subject, greeting, verified facts, action and signature. The assessments cover the full visible assembled messages.
hash_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({subject: exact_subject, body: exact_body}, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False). No whitespace or Unicode normalization is applied to either message string. Hashes are recomputed from visible strings; the source report content_hash uses a different JSON serialization and is not copied.

rubric_criteria.relevance: Does the message address the selected, evidence-supported objective?
rubric_criteria.clarity: Is the wording understandable and free from ambiguity?
rubric_criteria.personalization: Does it use appropriate verified context without unnecessary personal data?
rubric_criteria.call_to_action: Is the next step clear and proportionate, including no required action for appreciation?
rubric_criteria.tone: Is it respectful and appropriate for the selected objective and reminder stage?

method: The assistant read each returned exact subject/body, selected strategy, raw verified customer context and applicable offer before making criterion-level judgments. Validation pass status was not treated as a usefulness score. The failed sample had no visible draft and was excluded from scoring.
overall_limitations: Five successful drafts out of six generation attempts were available for qualitative assessment. The blocked decline_offer attempt remains part of the generation/validation denominator but has no usefulness score.
This is a single automated assistant assessment, not human feedback, a blinded study or evidence of customer satisfaction; human ratings remain uncollected.

The model generated bounded courtesy text, while most factual and action content was assembled deterministically. Scores do not isolate the model’s independent factual reasoning or generation capability.
These selected synthetic examples and the five-success subset do not support claims about real customer prevalence, broad model reliability, or improvement over the six-template cohort.
No live message was approved or delivered in this source report, and no activation, payment, support journey, conversion or comprehension outcome was observed.
Missing approved contact routes and customer-facing catalogue wording remain limitations of the full pipeline; invented links, numbers or promises are not acceptable substitutes.
Each judgment applies only to its exact canonical content hash and historical source context. Edited messages or changed evidence require reassessment.

rationales.relevance: The subject and required relationship line address appreciation without an offer. However, thanking the customer for time and consideration sounds like a response to a request or proposal that is not present in the supplied context.
rationales.clarity: The note is brief and understandable, but two consecutive thank-you statements are repetitive and consideration has no clear referent.
rationales.personalization: Only the greeting is individualized. The verified eight-month relationship does not inform the wording, and the generic wishes could be sent to any customer; adding private billing details would not be appropriate compensation.
rationales.call_to_action: There is no request to respond, pay or activate anything, which is proportionate for a pure appreciation message. A mandatory action is not needed for this objective.
rationales.tone: Courteous and positive, but the formal time-and-consideration phrase and all-the-best sign-off feel generic rather than specifically appreciative of an ongoing customer relationship.

assessments.overall_assessment: An acceptable, low-pressure appreciation note, with generic personalization and a courtesy phrase that is slightly misplaced for the objective.
overall_limitations: No human recipient has judged whether this wording feels sincere or relevant.
This assessment concerns the visible assembled message, not an observed change in customer engagement.

rationales.relevance: The selected offer and its 2GB benefit, 30-day validity, 90-day restriction and expiry match the active catalogue entry for POSTPAID_499. The stated offer remains unactivated, consistent with the prototype workflow.
rationales.clarity: The factual block is readable, but the synthetic version title, provisioning terminology and UTC expiry require customer-facing refinement. The pleasant opening provides no bridge into those technical terms.
rationales.personalization: The name is individualized, but neither the verified 24-month relationship nor other appropriate customer context is reflected. Hoping for a wonderful day does not add customer-specific relevance.
rationales.call_to_action: The text clearly avoids claiming activation, but asking the customer to discuss the offer through a usual channel supplies neither an approved destination nor concrete request instructions.
rationales.tone: Friendly and unpressured. The opening and closing are generic niceties, so the message does not particularly recognize loyalty.

assessments.overall_assessment: A relevant and polite offer message whose live courtesy wording does not resolve the fixed block’s clarity, personalization or CTA weaknesses.
overall_limitations: The synthetic offer cannot be provisioned, and no redemption or support-journey outcome was tested.
The wording of the factual block and support action comes from deterministic approved content; these weaknesses cannot be attributed solely to model generation.

rationales.relevance: The message presents the selected eligible offer for the active POSTPAID_499 subscription and preserves its exact benefit, terms and expiry. It does not invent a reason for the zero-activity window.
rationales.clarity: The fact labels aid scanning, but the synthetic version name, no-actual-provisioning wording and UTC expiry remain technical. The general well-wishing adds little explanation.
rationales.personalization: Aside from the greeting, the copy is generic. It offers no tailored optional help or welcome-back context, while correctly avoiding an unsupported claim that zero observed activity means the customer has left.
rationales.call_to_action: The offer is explicitly not activated, but the invitation to discuss it through an unspecified usual channel does not provide an actionable approved route.
rationales.tone: Polite and nonjudgmental about inactivity. The two well-wishing sentences are formulaic and do not make the re-engagement purpose more meaningful.

assessments.overall_assessment: A factually relevant, respectful offer with little substantive re-engagement tailoring and a vague practical next step.
overall_limitations: Zero active days does not establish dissatisfaction, churn intent, or a need for more data.
No real customer response or successful reactivation was observed, and fixed content limits the effect of the generated courtesy sentences.

rationales.relevance: The invoice reference, INR 350 remaining balance and 2026-11-12 due date match the selected partially paid invoice. The message does not incorrectly request the original INR 700 total.
rationales.clarity: The subject and labeled factual block make the reminder easy to understand. The generic opening and time-and-consideration closing do not add useful billing explanation.
rationales.personalization: The exact invoice, remaining balance, due date and greeting use the right verified context for this objective without including account, subscription or contact details.
rationales.call_to_action: Reviewing the balance and raising payment or dispute questions are proportionate, but usual billing channel and usual channel provide no specific approved destination or clear resolution path.
rationales.tone: Courteous and calm for a first reminder, preserving a support/dispute option and avoiding blame, threats or invented consequences.

assessments.overall_assessment: A grounded and respectful reminder with good factual personalization; the practical billing/support route remains underspecified.
overall_limitations: Correct invoice facts are supplied by deterministic assembly, so this sample does not establish that the model independently reasoned about payment status.
The reference-time balance must be checked again before any delivery; no actual payment or support outcome was tested.

rationales.relevance: The INR 1200 balance, invoice identifier and 2026-10-26 due date match the supplied record. Prior reminders on November 1 and 9 support the selected third-stage follow-up at the reference time.
rationales.clarity: Prompt attention clearly signals follow-up urgency without inventing a deadline, and the factual block is easy to scan. The description billing matter remains general until the invoice lines are read.
rationales.personalization: The greeting and invoice facts are accurate and pertinent. The text does not explicitly connect the firmer message to the verified earlier reminders, leaving some stage-specific context unused.
rationales.call_to_action: Prompt attention increases emphasis, but the unchanged usual-channel instruction still does not identify where or how the customer should resolve the balance or dispute it.
rationales.tone: Appropriately firm and respectful, with a dispute/support option and no unsupported penalties, service threats or shame.

assessments.overall_assessment: An accurate, appropriately firm follow-up whose generated opening improves emphasis but does not make the fixed CTA operational.
overall_limitations: The snapshot’s reminder history and outstanding balance are historical evidence, not proof the debt remains outstanding at a later delivery time.
This assessment does not establish collection effectiveness, legal suitability or recipient acceptance.

unscored_samples.reason: Generation was reported as blocked by validation and no subject/body was returned in the source report. No message content can be inspected, so usefulness scores are unavailable and are not zero.
unscored_samples.reported_error: Generated wording failed validation; no draft was created. Choose template generation or retry.
